title: Provable Security of LAX Against Linear Cryptanalysis
summary: LAX has provable bounds against differential cryptanalysis, but proving its security against linear cryptanalysis remains open.

formal_statement.body: The LAX family illustrates an ARX design strategy with provable bounds against differential cryptanalysis; the unresolved task is to establish provable security for LAX against linear cryptanalysis.

scope.domain: Linear and differential cryptanalysis of the LAX family of ARX constructions.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish provable security for LAX against linear cryptanalysis.

citations.label: Design Strategies for ARX with Provable Bounds: Sparx and LAX

progress.summary: The paper presents LAX as an ARX construction with provable bounds against differential cryptanalysis. It explicitly leaves provable security against linear cryptanalysis as an open problem.
citation_labels: Daniel Dinu et al., Design Strategies for ARX with Provable Bounds: Sparx and LAX
